hearth.social.no_economy: We've no coin here to take; perhaps another time.
hearth.social.cannot_afford: That'll be %s, and you haven't got it.
hearth.social.notice.banns: The banns are read: %s and %s are to be wed.
hearth.social.notice.wedding_off: The wedding of %s and %s will not take place.
hearth.social.notice.birth: A child, %s, is born to %s and %s.
hearth.social.notice.slain: %s was murdered. Anyone who knows anything, speak to the guard.
hearth.social.notice.left: %s has left town to seek a living elsewhere.
hearth.social.attended.wedding: You stand among the wedding guests of %s.
hearth.social.attended.feast: You raise a cup at the wedding feast in %s.
hearth.social.attended.funeral: You pay your respects with the people of %s.
hearth.social.talk.room: A room with a chest, by the day (%s).
hearth.social.talk.hire: I'd like to hire a mount (%s a day, %s deposit).
hearth.social.talk.buy_mount: I'd like to buy a mount (%s).
hearth.social.talk.harvest: Need a hand with the harvest? (up to %s)
hearth.social.talk.haul: Any hauling to be done? (%s a load)
hearth.social.talk.haul_in: Here's the stone from the quarry.
hearth.social.talk.quit_job: I can't finish the job, sorry.
hearth.social.talk.pledge: I would pledge my service to you, my lord.
hearth.social.talk.donate: A gift for the town's coffers (%s).
hearth.social.talk.law: How stands the law with me?
hearth.social.whats_on.quiet: Nothing much today; a quiet day.
hearth.social.whats_on.market_now: It's market day! The stalls are up in the square till evening.
hearth.social.whats_on.market_later: It's market day; the stalls go up at %s.
hearth.social.whats_on.festival_now: %s is on right now, in the square!
hearth.social.whats_on.feast: There's a wedding feast for %s and %s.
hearth.social.whats_on.court_now: The lord is holding court now.
hearth.social.road.none: Quiet on the roads lately. Nobody's come through with news.
hearth.social.inn.bed_ok: There's a bed for you. %s It's yours till the morning.
hearth.social.inn.bed_already: You've a bed here already tonight.
hearth.social.inn.full: I'm sorry, every bed's taken tonight.
hearth.social.inn.no_inn: We've no inn here to speak of.
hearth.social.inn.room_ok: Your room's ready, and the chest locks. %s Pay by the day; when the rent runs out you've %s days to clear it.
hearth.social.inn.room_more: Another day it is. Your things are safe.
hearth.social.inn.room_locked: This chest belongs to another guest's room.
hearth.social.inn.checked_out: Morning: your night at the inn is over, and your own bed is where you wake again.
hearth.social.inn.meal_1: Stew, bread and a mug of something warm. Eat up.
hearth.social.inn.meal_2: There's pie tonight, and plenty of it.
hearth.social.inn.meal_3: Sit down, sit down. Nobody leaves my table hungry.
hearth.social.bath.done: In you get. The water's hot... There, you'll smell like a person again.
hearth.social.stable.hired: Treat it well and bring it back to any stable for your deposit.
hearth.social.stable.bought: A fine animal. Yours now; look after it.
hearth.social.stable.hired_where: Your %s waits by the stable, saddled.
hearth.social.stable.yours: Your new %s waits by the stable, saddled.
hearth.social.stable.already: You've one of ours out already. Bring it back first.
hearth.social.stable.no_room: There's no room to bring a mount out here.
hearth.social.stable.returned: Back safe and sound. Here's %s of your deposit.
hearth.social.stable.too_far: Bring the beast here so I can see it.
hearth.social.stable.lost: You haven't got one of ours. If it's lost, the deposit's lost with it.
hearth.social.stable.died: Your hired mount has died. The deposit is forfeit.
hearth.social.wages.harvest_ok: Good! Bring in %s ripe crops from our fields, sow again behind you, and bring me the crop. You've %s minutes.
hearth.social.wages.haul_ok: Here's %s stone. Carry it to the builders and they'll pay you. You've %s minutes, and mind: it's the town's stone.
hearth.social.wages.busy: You've a job already. Finish that first.
hearth.social.wages.limit: That's enough work for one day. Come back tomorrow.
hearth.social.wages.nothing: Nothing ripe to bring in, sorry.
hearth.social.wages.no_room: You'll need your arms free to carry a load.
hearth.social.wages.town_poor: The town couldn't pay you, I'm afraid.
hearth.social.wages.short_load: That's not the load from the quarry.
hearth.social.wages.harvest_done: That's enough crops; take them back to %s.
hearth.social.wages.expired: You took too long; %s has given the job to someone else.
hearth.social.wages.hud.haul: Haul %s stone to the builders — %s left
hearth.social.market.sold: A good buy; that came all the way from %s.
hearth.social.market.sold_far: A good buy; that came from far-off %s country.
hearth.social.office.reeve.report: %s is a %s of %s souls. %s buildings are going up, %s waiting on goods. As for you, folk count you %s.
hearth.social.office.reeve.work: There's always work: the farmers (%s) could use a hand, and the quarry folk (%s) need stone hauled.
hearth.social.office.reeve.no_work: No paid work today, I'm afraid.
hearth.social.office.captain.wanted: You've some nerve. You're wanted here; %s settles it, or the cells do.
hearth.social.office.captain.quiet_1: Quiet, for now. Keep it that way.
hearth.social.office.captain.quiet_2: Wolves on the roads at night. Travel by day.
hearth.social.office.judge.wanted: The court has your name. %s, or you answer for it.
hearth.social.office.judge.clean: The court has nothing against you. Keep it so.
hearth.social.office.priest.alms: Bless you. The poor will eat tonight.
hearth.social.office.priest.none: No weddings, no burials. A quiet week, thank heaven.
hearth.social.office.builder.idle: Nothing on the go just now; the plans are drawn, the timber's coming.
hearth.social.office.lord.pledged: Then rise, %s. My house will remember it.
hearth.social.office.lord.realm: %s is mine to keep, and %s towns are known along the roads. You are counted %s among my people.
hearth.social.office.steward.thanks: The town thanks you. It will be written down.
hearth.social.line.festival.6: My feet ache and I don't care.
hearth.social.line.feast.4: I give it a year. No, I'm joking!
hearth.social.line.market.4: I'll take two, if you're asking.
hearth.social.line.court.3: The lord will hear you now.
hearth.social.line.table.2: Your throw, and mind the edge.
hearth.social.dice.title: Dice with %s
hearth.social.dice.turn_invalid: This turn: %s   (every picked die must score)
hearth.social.dice.status.hot: Hot dice! All six again with %s on the turn.
hearth.social.dice.status.folk_wins_hono: %s wins, and the honour with it.
hearth.social.dice.status.player_wins_ho: You win, and the honour is yours.
hearth.social.dice.refuse.distrust: I don't play with the likes of you.
hearth.social.dice.refuse.cheat: Cheat me once... Get away from my table.
hearth.social.dice.refuse.broke: You've cleaned me out for today.
hearth.social.dice.refuse.busy: I'm in the middle of a game.
hearth.social.dice.rules.title: How to score
hearth.social.dice.rules.single: A single 1 scores 100; a single 5 scores 50.
hearth.social.dice.rules.triple: Three of a kind: the face × 100 (three 1s: 1000).
hearth.social.dice.rules.more: Each die beyond three of a kind doubles it.
hearth.social.dice.rules.flow: Set aside scoring dice, then roll the rest or bank. Nothing scores: you lose the turn. All six set aside: roll them all again.
hearth.social.dice.say.careful.start.1: Small stakes and steady hands, eh?
hearth.social.dice.say.careful.folk_bust: Ah. I knew I should have stopped.
hearth.social.dice.say.careful.cheat.1: Weighted! I knew those were too lucky. Out!
hearth.social.dice.say.shrewd.start.1: Let's see what the bones say.
It happens, one roll in so many.
hearth.social.dice.say.shrewd.player_bus: You pushed one roll too far.
hearth.social.dice.say.shrewd.player_hot: Hot dice. Now it gets interesting.
hearth.social.dice.say.shrewd.player_win: You read the bones better than I did.
hearth.social.dice.say.shrewd.cheat.1: Ones and fives, ones and fives... those dice are loaded. Get out.
hearth.social.dice.say.bold.start.1: Throw, friend, and don't be shy!
hearth.social.dice.say.bold.player_hot.1: All six! Go on, go on!
hearth.social.dice.say.bold.player_win.1: Well thrown! Drinks on you, then!
hearth.social.dice.say.bold.cheat.1: You cheat at dice? At MY table? Get out before I throw you out!
hearth.social.dice.say.reckless.start.1: Big stakes or none at all!
hearth.social.dice.say.reckless.folk_ban: Even I know when to... no I don't.
hearth.social.dice.say.reckless.folk_bus: One more roll is always one too many.
hearth.social.dice.say.reckless.player_b: You should have rolled once more!
hearth.social.dice.say.reckless.player_h: Yes! Roll them all! Roll them!
hearth.social.dice.say.reckless.cheat.1: Cheater! Even I don't cheat! Mostly!
hearth.social.dice.say.sour.cheat.1: I watched every throw. Loaded. Thief! Guards!
hearth.social.command.not_in_town: You are not in a settlement.
hearth.social.command.day: Ran the day's social business for %s.
hearth.social.command.no_match: Nobody here is free to marry.
item.hearth.loaded_dice.warning: Play them at a dice table, if you dare.
